definitions.explanation: The time period immediately following a meal. Commonly used in contexts about medicine, activities, or routines that should happen after eating.

examples.japanese: {食後|しょくご}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{薬|くすり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{飲|の}む。
{食後|しょくご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧コーヒー。

examples.english: I like to take a walk after meals.

notes:
{食後|しょくご} refers to the time period right after eating. It is a compound of {食|しょく} (eating) + {後|ご} (after), following the same pattern as many other time-related compounds.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {食後|しょくご}に{薬|くすり}を{飲|の}む: take medicine after meals
- {食後|しょくご}のデザート: after-meal dessert
- {食後|しょくご}のコーヒー: after-meal coffee
- {食後|しょくご}30{分|ぷん}: 30 minutes after eating

RELATED TIME-OF-MEAL WORDS:
- {食前|しょくぜん}: before a meal
- {食間|しょっかん}: between meals (used for medicine timing)
- {食事|しょくじ}{中|ちゅう}: during a meal

USAGE:
Frequently seen on medicine labels and prescriptions. Pharmacists will specify {食後|しょくご} vs. {食前|しょくぜん} vs. {食間|しょっかん} for when to take medication.
